The overall hotspot activity in November 2023 for southern ASEAN was generally higher than previous years except for November 2019 for which was the worst year for peatland fires after the 2015. For Mekong subregion the overall hotspot counts in November 2023 were mostly comparable to previous years however to note that the dry season for northern ASEAN starts in December.
